architecture_deltas.proposed_change: Add a first-class PerceptualEmbeddingHandle (PEH) owned by the one-module perception runtime. After mtmd vision encoding, bind the output to frame_id, source_epoch, ROI hash, visual-token geometry, model hash, mmproj hash, processor/runtime build, backend/device and observed_at. MVC may read the handle. If semantic escalation is required and compatibility remains valid, the same handle feeds decode without a second vision encode. Invalidate/rebuild on stale frame, changed ROI/tokenization, model/mmproj/runtime incompatibility or failed restart provenance.
architecture_deltas.expected_benefit: Makes the existing QNDRF one-encode/zero-or-one-decode claim executable and measurable; exposes exact encode reuse rather than relying on opaque server cache behavior.
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: PEH retention/copy cost and lifetime complexity dominate savings; direct decode or dedicated light encoder remains simpler/Pareto-superior.
architecture_deltas.discriminating_test: FULL_QWEN vs stock server recurrence vs PEH encode->MVC->optional delayed decode vs dedicated-light-encoder baseline on matched GUI episodes.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Remove PEH path and retain existing QNDRF/full-Qwen or dedicated MVC baseline; no canonical promotion until H1-H3 differential evidence.
